name: research-cap
description: Bound an open-ended research task before it starts: how many sources, how deep, and when to stop and synthesize.
policy: cap_tight=yes (conf>=0.80) -> research_capped at max_browser_sources. synthesis_ready=yes -> stop fetching, synthesize now. depth=deep only at conf>=0.80, otherwise standard.

cap_tight.instructions: Can this be answered well with at most 5 sources instead of an exhaustive search?

criteria.yes: Can this be answered well with at most 5 sources instead of an exhaustive search?

depth.instructions: How deep should the research go?

synthesis_ready.instructions: Do we already have enough signal to synthesize a useful answer without more fetching?

criteria.yes: Do we already have enough signal to synthesize a useful answer without more fetching?
